title: Finance Executive- Accounts Payable
description:
AG Hotels is an exciting and rapidly growing hospitality management company with a growing portfolio across the UK. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Finance Executive to join our central finance team based in India. The successful candidate will support the day-to-day financial operations of multiple entities and hotels. This is a hands-on role involving Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank reconciliations, accounting entries, supplier and customer reconciliations, month-end support, and financial reporting. The role requires someone who is organised, accurate, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced, multi-entity environment. 
 AG Hotels India 
 Reports to: Finance Manager / Finance Head 
 Process supplier invoices and ensure appropriate approvals and supporting documents are available. Assist with the preparation of supplier payments and payment runs. Maintain accurate Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable records. Raise customer invoices and follow up on outstanding balances where required. Perform supplier, customer, bank, and intercompany reconciliations. Post day-to-day accounting transactions and journal entries accurately. Ensure expenses and invoices are correctly coded to the relevant entity, department, cost centre, and nominal ledger. Assist in investigating and resolving invoice, payment, and reconciliation discrepancies. Support the preparation of month-end accounts, including accruals and prepayments. Assist with revenue and operational reconciliations where required. Monitor outstanding supplier and customer balances and highlight unusual or long-outstanding items. Process employee expenses, company card transactions, and other business expenses. Maintain proper accounting records and supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes. Assist with VAT-related reconciliations and the preparation of supporting information. Support internal and external audit requirements. Prepare regular reports and schedules as requested by the Finance Manager or senior management. Liaise with suppliers, hotel teams, operations, and other internal stakeholders to resolve financial queries. Assist in improving finance processes, controls, and reporting procedures. Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and approval procedures. Carry out any other finance or accounting duties assigned by the Line Manager or senior management. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. Ideally pursuing or part-qualified in CA, CMA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification. Good understanding of accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping. Minimum 24 years of relevant accounting or finance experience. Experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank reconciliation, and general ledger accounting. Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, or similar systems will be an advantage. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Good communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn, take ownership, and develop within the finance function.

title: Associate Executive
description:
Only for Male Candidate JOB DESCRIPTION - Executive Associate to the Founder Work Mode: Hybrid (Field + Office) Office Locations: Defence Colony & Kailash Colony, New Delhi Employment Type: Full-Time Preferred Candidate: Male About the Role This is not a conventional Personal Assistant position. The Executive Associate will work directly with the Founder, acting as an extension of the executive office while supporting daily business operations, client coordination, project management, documentation, travel, and strategic execution. This role offers direct exposure to consulting, business management, executive decisionmaking, operations, project coordination, and client relationship management. It is ideal for individuals who wish to build a long-term career in business operations and leadership. Key Responsibilities - Executive Support • Assist the Founder during meetings, business discussions, presentations and client interactions. • Accompany the Founder on official meetings, site visits and business travel whenever required. • Manage calendars, appointments and schedules. • Prepare meeting files, reports and required documents. • Maintain daily execution trackers and task management systems. • Ensure timely completion of commitments and follow-ups. Meeting & Project Coordination • Schedule meetings with clients, consultants and internal teams. • Prepare meeting agendas. • Record professional Minutes of Meeting (MOM). • Share action points with stakeholders. • Monitor progress of assigned tasks. • Coordinate project timelines and deliverables. Client Relationship Management • Maintain professional communication with clients. • Coordinate drawings, layouts, photographs and project documentation. • Share project updates. • Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and clients. Office Administration When the Founder is travelling or attending field assignments, the Executive Associate will independently coordinate office operations. Responsibilities include: • Managing office workflow • Coordinating designers, draftsmen and consultants • Maintaining project files • Organising digital and physical documentation • Handling official emails and correspondence • Coordinating with vendors and service providers Accounts & Documentation • Coordinate pending payment follow-ups. • Maintain invoice records. • Coordinate with accounts department. • Maintain business documentation. • Ensure accurate filing of project information. Travel Coordination • Assist with official travel planning. • Coordinate travel schedules. • Maintain travel documentation. • Be available for business travel whenever required. Learning Opportunities This position offers practical exposure to: • Business Consulting • Executive Management • Client Relationship Management • Project Coordination • Operations Management • Business Documentation • Strategic Planning • Leadership Development Desired Skills • Excellent communication skills in Hindi and English • Strong written communication • Professional etiquette • Excellent organisational abilities • Strong planning and execution skills • Ability to multitask • High attention to detail • Microsoft Office & Google Workspace proficiency • Basic understanding of AutoCAD or technical drawings (preferred) • Ability to maintain confidentiality • Positive attitude and problem-solving mindset Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is: • Honest and trustworthy • Highly disciplined • Professionally presented • Punctual and dependable • Calm under pressure • Quick to learn • Detail-oriented • Comfortable working in dynamic environments • Flexible with work schedules • Willing to travel whenever required • Capable of representing the company professionally Why Join Shubh Aakar Energy? Joining Shubh Aakar Energy means becoming part of a dynamic consulting environment where every day offers new learning opportunities. You will receive: • Direct mentorship from the Founder • Exposure to real-world business operations • Opportunities to work with premium residential, commercial and industrial projects • Experience across consulting, design coordination and business management • Long-term career growth based on performance • A professional and entrepreneurial work environment Working Model Hybrid Working • Field assignments with the Founder around Delhi NCR, International and Domestic. • Office responsibilities from Kailash Colony when not travelling • Reporting point for field work: Defence Colony • Official travel expenses borne by the company Who Should Apply? This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking more than a routine office role. If you enjoy solving problems, coordinating people, managing projects, learning directly from experienced leadership, travelling, and taking ownership of responsibilities, this position offers exceptional professional exposure and long-term career growth. Why This Role Matters At Shubh Aakar Energy Private Limited, every project begins with detailed site visits, client discussions, technical observations, and strategic planning. During these visits, the Founder works closely with clients, architects, consultants, contractors, and project teams to understand project requirements, identify practical solutions, and recommend design or planning modifications. The Executive Associate plays a critical role in ensuring that these discussions are accurately documented and translated into clear, structured, and implementation-ready outputs. This position acts as the bridge between on-site consultations and the final deliverables provided to clients. The selected candidate will carefully understand discussions, observations, sketches, and instructions shared during meetings and site visits, and convert them into professional written documentation, AutoCAD mark-ups, project notes, requirement sheets, and other structured formats that can be easily understood by clients, architects, designers, and execution teams. AutoCAD & Documentation Responsibilities AutoCAD proficiency is an important part of this role because most client discussions and site recommendations ultimately need to be reflected on architectural drawings. The Executive Associate will not be expected to independently design projects, but will work closely with the Founder to accurately translate discussions and recommendations into updated AutoCAD drawings. Typical responsibilities include: • Updating existing AutoCAD drawings based on instructions provided by the Founder. • Preparing clear mark-ups showing proposed modifications. • Converting site discussions into professional requirement documents. • Creating structured recommendation sheets for clients. • Coordinating with architects, draftsmen, and designers to ensure drawings accurately reflect the recommended changes. • Maintaining proper documentation, revision records, and project files. • Ensuring every recommendation is communicated in a clear, visual, and implementation-ready format. The ability to convert technical discussions into organised documentation and visually understandable drawings is one of the most valuable aspects of this position. It enables seamless communication between the consulting team, clients, architects, contractors, and execution teams while ensuring every recommendation can be implemented accurately and efficiently. Shubh Aakar Energy Private Limited "Building Better Spaces. Enabling Better Growth."

description:

Contact: ASHISH MITTAL (9810354808)

Job Description We are looking for an experienced, responsible and highly accountable Senior Accountant / Accounts In-Charge who can independently manage the day-to-day accounting, statutory compliance, banking, receivables, payables and inventory-related accounting of the company. The candidate should be hands-on, systematic, disciplined and responsible for the accuracy, completeness and timely completion of all assigned accounting work . Key Responsibilities Handle complete day-to-day accounting of the company. Prepare and file GST Returns , including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST compliances. Reconcile GST input/output and ensure correctness of GST records. Handle TDS calculations, deductions, payments and TDS returns . Perform daily bank reconciliation for all company bank accounts. Monitor bank entries and ensure that all receipts and payments are properly accounted for. Prepare sales invoices, tax invoices, debit notes and credit notes. Handle e-Invoicing and E-Way Bills , wherever applicable. Check invoices for correct rates, quantities, GST and other commercial details. Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. Perform regular customer and vendor reconciliation . Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare customer ageing reports. Follow up internally regarding overdue customer payments. Maintain and verify accounts payable and accounts receivable. Ensure that purchases, sales and expenses are correctly booked under appropriate accounting heads. Reconcile stock/inventory records with accounts . Verify incoming stock, purchase entries and supporting documents. Ensure that stock received is properly entered against the relevant Purchase Order / GRN / supplier invoice. Identify discrepancies between physical stock, software stock and accounting records. Maintain proper accounting records for the concerned company/business entity. Conduct ledger scrutiny and identify incorrect, duplicate or missing entries. Prepare monthly accounting reports and reconciliations. Assist in month-end and year-end closing. Coordinate with CA / auditors for GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audit requirements. Maintain complete supporting documentation and proper filing of accounting records. Ensure that statutory payments and returns are completed before their respective due dates. Daily End-of-Day Reporting Mandatory The Accounts In-Charge will be required to submit a Daily End-of-Day Accounts Report before leaving the office . The daily report should clearly mention: Bank reconciliation status. Payments received from customers. Payments made to suppliers and other parties. Customer outstanding / overdue payment status. Invoices generated during the day. Purchase entries completed. Debit notes / credit notes issued or pending. GST / TDS work completed or pending. Stock or inventory discrepancies noticed. Customer / supplier reconciliation completed. Any accounting issue, discrepancy or pending approval. Work completed during the day. Work pending at the end of the day. Reason for any pending work. Priority work planned for the next working day. No important accounting work should remain pending without being mentioned in the Daily End-of-Day Report. Accountability & Ownership This position requires a person who takes complete ownership and accountability for the assigned work . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that: Assigned work is completed within the required timeline. Accounting entries are accurate and supported by proper documents. GST and TDS compliances are completed correctly and on time. Bank reconciliation is updated regularly. Customer outstanding is properly monitored. Customer and vendor ledgers are properly reconciled. Stock received and stock appearing in accounts/software are properly matched. Mistakes, discrepancies or missing documents are identified and reported immediately. Incorrect or incomplete information is not ignored. Pending work is reported clearly instead of being carried forward without explanation. Management is informed immediately if any issue can affect accounts, taxation, payments, customer outstanding or statutory compliance. Daily reports reflect the actual status of work and should not contain incorrect or misleading information. The employee will be accountable for the correctness and completion of the work handled by him/her and is expected to verify the work rather than simply enter data into the system. Candidate Requirements Education: B.Com / M.Com preferred. CA Inter candidates with relevant practical experience may also apply. Experience: Minimum 4–8 years of practical accounting experience . Experience in a manufacturing company will be strongly preferred. Required Skills The candidate must have good practical knowledge of: GST GSTR-1 GSTR-3B GST Reconciliation TDS TDS Returns Bank Reconciliation Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Customer Outstanding Vendor Reconciliation Customer Reconciliation Sales Invoicing Purchase Accounting Debit Notes / Credit Notes E-Invoicing E-Way Bills Inventory / Stock Reconciliation Ledger Scrutiny Tally Prime / ERP Accounting Software MS Excel Daily MIS / Management Reporting Most Important Requirement We are looking for a person who takes ownership of the work and reports the actual position to management every day . The candidate should not merely make accounting entries. He/she must verify whether the entries, balances, invoices, bank transactions, statutory returns and stock records are correct. The person should be capable of independently identifying: What work has been completed. What work is pending. Why it is pending. What discrepancy has been found. Who needs to take action. What needs to be completed next. Preferred Candidate We prefer a candidate who is: Responsible and accountable. Detail-oriented. Strong in numbers and reconciliation. Able to work independently. Disciplined about deadlines. Regular in submitting daily reports. Good at maintaining proper documentation. Comfortable checking the work rather than simply entering data. Able to identify mistakes and resolve discrepancies. Honest and transparent in reporting. Able to take complete responsibility for assigned accounting functions. Willing to report problems immediately rather than hide or postpone them.

Purpose of your role The individual will act as an agent for growth of the Systematic Investment business (primarily focussing on Systematic Fixed Income), remain focused on efficiency and profitability and ensure excellence of client service. As a key member of a growing team, the successful candidate will be able to influence how the Systematic proposition evolves to meet client needs. Accordingly, having an entrepreneurial approach which is open to changing how we do things to better support our clients is key to success in this role. The individual will join Systematic Investment Group, supporting client-facing and product activity for Fidelitys global distribution business. The individual will work closely with the Systematic Investment Group Investment Directors and Investment Specialists liaise with the Portfolio Managers and the global sales force. Responsibilities include the production of a wide range of written material to support client engagement. This includes pitch books and product presentations, reporting materials, marketing and training collateral, editorial content and thought leadership, RFP/RFI submissions, competitor analysis and responses to client queries. Collaboration with Investment Directors to design, create and enhance collateral to articulate Fidelity’s capabilities - both on existing investment strategies as well as evolving disciplines. The individual’s specific responsibilities will include: Production of presentation materials, including pitch books and client updates and working with teams globally for onboarding new clients and mandates. Working with Fidelity’s internal distribution teams to support their knowledge and promotion of Fidelity Systematic Investment portfolios and broader investment capabilities. RFP/RFI support, articulating Fidelity Systematic Investment Group’s investment process and disciplines (both broadly and for specific portfolios.) Query resolution, specifically ensuring that ad hoc fund and strategy queries from clients/sales force are answered quickly and accurately, to be done in concert with global team. Working with the India-based Investment Fund Analysts to support regular standard fund reporting requirements. As required, cover regular reporting, working with others in the team to analyse performance, attribution and positioning data and articulate investment messages to clients and distribution teams. Liaising with colleagues globally to share information and best practice and to help provide information to clients in a range of formats, including written material, internal briefing or training, and participating in client calls or meetings as appropriate.

Experience in investment writing and content production (in a variety of formats.) Broad knowledge of wholesale and institutional client types. Excellent capability with Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Familiarity with financial data - using Thomson Reuters Datastream, Bloomberg, Eikon and or other third party systems. Strong data and analytical skills. Desired experience and qualifications The core skillsets required for this role are strong commendation skills, an entrepreneurial approach and going the extra mile for clients. Experience range between 5 to 10 years Context, understanding of the systematic and quantitative analysis and investment process and its drivers, coupled with a knack and knowledge of various quantitative investment models. Knowledge of key institutional client types and their requirements (e.g. insurance, banking and pensions.) A grounding in portfolio theory and investment concepts. While not a pre-requisite for the role, any additional technical expertise which could assist in the automation of regular tasks is a plus. title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager Location: Gurugram
 Department: Accounts & Finance
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Experience: 5+ Years
 Qualification: CA / CPA preferred
 Industry: International Education / Higher Education About the Role We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to manage accounting and financial operations for our Canadian higher-education and associated business entities. The role will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, statutory compliance, audit coordination, revenue and receivables management, and team leadership. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to international accounting, Canadian accounting practices, IFRS/Canada GAAP, QuickBooks, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis . The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Operations, Marketing, IT, institutional stakeholders, vendors, students, and senior Finance leadership. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Financial Operations Oversee day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts. Manage accounting activities across Canadian higher-education entities and associated group companies. Review appropriate booking and classification of income and expenses in QuickBooks . Ensure accurate revenue recognition and classification of deferred revenue. Monitor timely invoicing and accounting of revenues. Review Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable transactions. Ensure refunds, commissions, incentives, petty cash and other financial trackers are updated accurately and on time. Review credit card statements and ensure expenses are appropriately approved and within budget. Review and finalize monthly books of accounts before submission to the Controller and CFO. 2. MIS & Financial Reporting Prepare and present accurate weekly and monthly MIS reports. Prepare Actual vs. Budget analysis for revenue, enrollment, expenses and profitability. Prepare entity-wise financial analysis and management reports. Monitor enrollment/deposit status and financial performance across entities. Track lead-generation costs, conversion costs and associated financial metrics. Prepare month-end review reports and highlight key variances and financial insights to management. 3. Budgeting & Forecasting Lead annual budgeting exercises in collaboration with Sales and other business teams. Translate annual budgets into monthly and periodic targets. Monitor actual performance against budgets and identify significant variances. Prepare rolling forecasts based on actual business performance. Work closely with Sales and Marketing to align revenue targets, lead-generation budgets and business expenditure. Ensure expenses remain within approved budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization. 4. Revenue & Receivables Management Ensure correct classification of revenue and deferred revenue. Monitor Accounts Receivable and follow up on outstanding receivables. Ensure bad debts are appropriately identified and recorded. Review student-related receivables and support timely collections. Monitor revenue realization against business targets. Work with Sales and Operations teams to improve revenue visibility and collection efficiency. 5. Audit & Statutory Compliance Coordinate internal and external audit requirements. Ensure timely preparation and submission of financial information required for audits and regulatory reviews. Ensure compliance with applicable IFRS / Canadian accounting standards and statutory requirements . Support financial submissions required for institutional licensing, certification and regulatory renewals. Review audit observations and ensure corrective actions are implemented within agreed timelines. Ensure timely completion of recurring financial and statutory compliances while avoiding penalties and interest. 6. Process Improvement & Financial Controls Review existing Finance policies, processes and SOPs and recommend improvements. Drive standardization across accounting and reporting processes. Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency. Strengthen financial controls and ensure adherence to approved processes. Ensure consistent and accurate accounting practices across entities. 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Sales, Operations, Brand & Marketing, IT and other functions on financial and business matters. Participate in regular cross-functional meetings to review business performance, budgets, revenue and operational requirements. Collaborate with Canadian teams, institutions, vendors, third parties and other stakeholders. Provide financial insights to support business decisions. 8. Team Management & Development Lead and manage the accounting team responsible for respective entities. Set clear goals, KPIs and performance expectations for team members. title: DGM Control Assurance
description:
This role will be responsible for establishing and strengthening the organization's internal audit, internal financial controls (IFC), risk management, and governance frameworks. It will provide independent assurance on the effectiveness of internal controls, risk mitigation measures, and compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements. Working closely with business leaders, the incumbent will identify control gaps, recommend process improvements, monitor implementation of corrective actions, and enhance the overall control environment. 
 Internal Audit Strategy & Assurance Develop and implement the annual risk-based internal audit plan, ensuring comprehensive coverage of financial, operational, compliance, and strategic risks. Ensure timely execution of audit engagements through internal and external audit partners in line with the approved audit calendar. Oversee the quality and effectiveness of audit reviews and ensure timely issuance of audit reports with actionable recommendations. Strengthen the internal audit framework to meet statutory requirements and support effective governance. 
 Internal Controls & Governance Design, implement, and continuously enhance the organization's Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and operational control framework. Establish and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), control matrices, and governance frameworks across business functions. Periodically assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and recommend improvements to strengthen the control environment. Review and update internal control policies in line with business requirements, regulatory changes, and industry best practices. 
 Risk Management & Control Assurance Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and operational risks, and drive implementation of corrective and preventive actions by co-creating solutions with business units. Build a robust control assurance framework by partnering with functional teams to embed risk ownership and accountability. Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of audit recommendations and report the status of corrective actions. Lead the organization's fraud risk management framework, including fraud prevention, detection, investigation, and monitoring mechanisms . 
 Regulatory Compliance & Corporate Governance Assess the effectiveness of the organization's regulatory compliance framework and recommend improvements where required. Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) requirements, and other applicable regulatory and governance standards. Support statutory, internal, and regulatory audits by providing relevant documentation, insights, and assurance regarding the effectiveness of internal controls. Promote a culture of ethics, compliance, and accountability across the organization. 
 Reporting & Stakeholder Management Prepare and present periodic audit and risk reports, including key observations, risk assessments, and remediation status, to the CFO and CEO. Provide independent assurance to senior management and the Audit Committee on the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Engage with business leaders to provide advisory support on governance, process improvements, and risk mitigation initiatives. Liaise with external auditors, statutory auditors, and regulatory authorities on audit and compliance matters. 
 Continuous Improvement, Transformation & Innovation Drive continuous improvement initiatives by strengthening governance, simplifying processes, and enhancing the organization's control environment through standardized and efficient practices. Lead the adoption of digital transformation, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve audit effectiveness, risk identification, control monitoring, and decision-making. Benchmark governance, risk management, and internal audit practices against industry best practices and implement innovative solutions to enhance organizational effectiveness and control maturity. Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and technology-enabled assurance by promoting the use of emerging technologies to proactively address business risks, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic objectives. 
 Qualification Background: Chartered Accountant Experience: 12 -14 years of progressive experience in Internal Audit, Risk Management, Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Compliance, or Governance. 
 Prior Experience/Background: Experience in internal audit functions for a listed organization or a reputed consulting firm. Strong exposure to enterprise risk management, internal controls, process audits, fraud risk management, and corporate governance. Should have team-handling experience with CAs. Proven experience in presenting audit findings and risk assessments to senior leadership. Technical Skills: Companies Act, Internal Financial Controls (IFC), Corporate Governance, and applicable regulatory requirements. ERPs (SAP, Oracle, etc.), audit management tools, and data analytics platforms (Power BI, ACL, IDEA, SQL, etc.). Automation, AI-enabled audit techniques, continuous auditing, and digital risk monitoring.

title: Accounts & Finance Manager (Ecommerce Segment Only)
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager with strong hands-on experience in the Ecommerce/D2C industry . The candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting, financial reporting, statutory compliance, GST and TDS filings, reconciliations, and preparation/review of financial statements. Ecommerce industry experience is mandatory. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Accounting & Financial Reporting Manage day-to-day accounting and financial transactions. Maintain accurate books of accounts and accounting records. Prepare and review Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements . Perform monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities. Review journal entries, provisions, accruals and expense accounting. Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable. Conduct regular bank, ledger and balance-sheet reconciliations. GST & TDS Compliance Prepare and file GST returns such as GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST returns. Ensure proper reconciliation of GSTR-2B with purchase records/books . Handle TDS calculations, payments and TDS return filings . Ensure timely issuance of TDS certificates and compliance with applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate with consultants/auditors for GST and TDS-related matters. Identify and resolve discrepancies in GST, TDS and accounting records. Ecommerce Finance Operations Handle accounting and reconciliation of Ecommerce/Marketplace transactions . Reconcile sales, collections, commissions, marketplace fees, refunds, cancellations and returns. Reconcile settlements received from platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and other marketplaces , as applicable. Reconcile payment gateways, COD collections, online payments and bank settlements . Track RTO, NDR, refunds, discounts and marketplace deductions . Ensure accurate accounting of ecommerce sales and related expenses. Monitor marketplace receivables and settlement discrepancies. MIS & Analysis Prepare monthly and periodic financial MIS reports . Analyse revenue, expenses, gross margin and profitability. Prepare management reports and financial dashboards. Provide financial insights to management for business decision-making. Monitor working capital and cash flow requirements. Audit & Compliance Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants and internal auditors. Support statutory audit, tax audit and other financial audits. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and statutory requirements. Maintain proper documentation and financial records. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Strong knowledge of Accounting and Finance . Hands-on experience in Balance Sheet and P&L preparation/review . Strong knowledge of GST and TDS compliance and return filing . Experience in Ecommerce/Marketplace accounting and reconciliation . Good understanding of marketplace settlements and payment gateways. Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and reconciliation. Experience with accounting software such as Tally Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills Candidates must have prior hands-on experience in the Ecommerce / D2C / Online Retail industry. .

Job Title: Finance Head (CFO in the Making) : Urgent Hiring 
 Location: Ghaziabad, India 
 Industry: Manufacturing 
 Experience: 10+ Years 
 Qualification: CA / CMA : Seek Poeple living 10 KM radius from Pilkhuwa , Ghaziabad 
 About the Role: We are looking for a dynamic Finance Head who is on the path to becoming a CFO within the next 3-5 years. The ideal candidate will be a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) with over 10 years of experience in finance and accounting, specifically in a manufacturing plant setup. 
 The role demands a strategic thinker who can lead financial planning, ensure compliance, optimize costs, and drive profitability while working closely with the senior leadership team. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Financial Strategy & Planning Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with business goals. 
 Drive long-term financial planning and forecasting. 
 Optimize capital structure and financial performance to support growth. 
 2. Accounting & Compliance Oversee end-to-end finance and accounting operations for the manufacturing unit. 
 Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting (MIS, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow statements, etc.). 
 Ensure statutory compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, and other regulatory requirements. 
 Coordinate with auditors for internal, statutory, and tax audits. 
 3. Cost & Budget Management Implement cost control measures and identify areas for cost reduction. 
 Monitor and analyze production costs, material costs, and operational expenditures. 
 Prepare and track annual budgets, CAPEX, and operational expenses. 
 4. Treasury & Cash Flow Management Ensure efficient working capital management and fund utilization. 
 Manage banking relationships and oversee fundraising, loans, and credit facilities. 
 Monitor cash flow and ensure liquidity for smooth operations. 
 5. Business & Financial Risk Management Assess financial risks and implement robust internal controls. 
 Ensure risk mitigation strategies are in place for currency fluctuations, interest rate changes, and financial contingencies. 
 Support management in investment decisions and financial feasibility analysis. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Lead and mentor the finance & accounts team. 
 Establish best practices in financial governance and reporting. 
 Collaborate with plant operations, procurement, HR, and sales teams for cross-functional financial efficiency. 
 Key Requirements: Qualification: CA / CMA (Mandatory). Experience: Minimum 10+ years in Finance & Accounts within a Manufacturing Plant. Technical Skills: Strong expertise in plant finance, costing, budgeting, and financial planning. Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Tally, etc.). Strong knowledge of taxation, compliance, and financial regulations. Leadership: Experience in leading finance teams and working with senior management. Strategic Thinking: Ability to scale financial operations and prepare for a CFO role in 3-5 years. 
 Why Join Us? Opportunity to be groomed into a CFO role in the next 3-5 years. 
 Be part of a fast-growing manufacturing organization. 
 High-impact role with direct exposure to leadership. 
 If you are a seasoned finance professional with manufacturing experience, looking for a strategic leadership role, we invite you to apply!

Key Skills: Finance and Accounts,GST,Manufacturing,Plant Accounting,Financial Operations,Finance,Commercial Finance,Operations

JOB PURPOSE To support the supervisor in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of warehouse, inventory, and fulfillment operations while maintaining high service standards, process compliance, and operational accuracy. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Manage inward and outward inventory movements of books and journals accurately and on time. Ensure timely submission of indents to affiliates and production teams with appropriate approvals and documentation. Share deviation reports with affiliates and production teams as required. Process sales and approval returns efficiently and share relevant reports within stipulated timelines. Ensure timely dispatch of inventory to customers and proactively track deliveries to closure. Support book order processing activities and ensure order fulfillment within agreed timelines. Ensure smooth execution of warehouse operations and related processes. Submit weekly and monthly work plans to the reporting manager and independently execute assigned tasks. Provide backup support to team members as required to ensure business continuity. Maintain clear, concise, and professional verbal and written communication. Prepare and maintain operational reports and MIS; demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Contribute constructive ideas and feedback to improve operational efficiency and team performance. Ensure strict adherence to all operational processes and Internal Financial Control Requirements (IFCR). Promote and uphold Sage Values and Code of Conduct, escalating any concerns or non-compliance to the manager. Liaise with Sales, Finance, and Customer Services teams regarding the implementation, interpretation, and adoption of Sage policies. Review service level agreements (SLAs) periodically and identify opportunities for process optimization. Engage with business partners, sales teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to review and act upon feedback. Conduct weekly and monthly review meetings with the reporting manager and proactively escalate issues impacting service delivery. Undertake additional responsibilities and projects assigned by management from time to time. Maintain a "Zero Error" approach to all assigned tasks and stakeholder interactions. Promote discipline, professionalism, and compliance within the team and organization. FUTURE DEVELOPMENT RESPONSIBILITIES Support vendor management activities relating to freight, packing, warehousing, and fulfillment. Assist the Line Manager in managing day-to-day operations with warehouse and fulfillment vendors. Maintain and update MIS related to domestic and international freight costs and share reports as required. Support timely contract renewals and vendor governance activities for freight, warehouse, and fulfillment partners. SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Essential Skills Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Good vocabulary and professional business communication. Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities. High levels of punctuality, accountability, flexibility, and attention to detail. Qualifications Bachelors degree in any discipline. Experience 3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, fulfillment, logistics, or a related operational function. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. title: Manager/ Senior Manager- Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Purpose / Summary   The Manager / Senior Manager – Finance & Accounts is responsible for the accurate, timely and compliant execution of core finance operations — including month-end close, reconciliations, taxation, and accounts payable/receivable — for their area of responsibility. This is a hands-on leadership role: the incumbent supervises a team of accountants and finance executives, ensures day-to-day processes run smoothly and controls are consistently followed, and provides the leadership team with reliable, well-supported financial information. Working closely with the GM – Finance & Accounts, the role holder translates group finance policy into consistent day-to-day practice, resolves operational issues as they arise, and drives continuous improvement in accuracy, compliance and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant (CA/CPA) with strong, hands-on experience across core accounting functions, who is equally comfortable managing a team and staying close to the detail. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Reporting & Accounting 
  Execute the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close process for assigned entities/functions, meeting agreed deadlines and accuracy standards.
 Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, provisions and intercompany postings ahead of GM sign-off.
 Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring open items are aged, tracked and resolved in a timely manner.
 Prepare accurate P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statements with supporting schedules for management review.
 Support the GM – Finance & Accounts in preparing leadership and management reporting packs.
 Ensure accounting entries and documentation comply with applicable accounting standards and group policy. 
 Budgeting & Forecasting 
 Support the annual budgeting and periodic reforecasting process, coordinating inputs from department and cost-centre owners.
 Prepare monthly budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual variance reports, with clear root-cause commentary.
 Track key financial and operational metrics, flagging risks, cost overruns and opportunities to the GM in a timely manner.
 Assist with cash flow monitoring and working capital tracking, escalating funding requirements as needed.

 Taxation & Compliance 
 Manage timely preparation, review and filing of direct and indirect tax returns (income tax, GST/VAT, TDS/withholding tax) in coordination with external advisors.
 Ensure accurate tax provisioning, reconciliation of tax accounts, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
 Support statutory and regulatory compliance activity, including statutory filings, registers and the compliance calendar.
 Respond to routine tax queries, notices and audit requests, escalating complex matters to the GM/CFO.
 Stay current on changes in tax and regulatory requirements relevant to the entity's operations.

 Accounts Payable & Receivable 
 Oversee end-to-end AP operations — vendor invoice processing, three-way matching, approvals and payment runs — ensuring adherence to delegated authority.
 Oversee AR operations including invoicing, collections and cash application, driving improvement in DSO and reduction of overdue balances.
 Maintain accurate AP/AR ageing and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and disputes.
 Monitor vendor and customer master data integrity, including controls over changes to banking details.

 Audit & Internal Controls 
 Coordinate with statutory and internal auditors — preparing schedules, responding to queries and closing out action points on time.
 Support the GM in maintaining and testing internal controls, the risk and controls matrix, and segregation of duties.
 Ensure a clean, well-documented audit trail from source data through to reported results.
 Identify and remediate control gaps within own area of responsibility, escalating systemic issues to the GM.

 Team Management & Process Improvement 
 Supervise, coach and develop a team of accountants/finance executives, setting clear priorities and reviewing quality of output.
 Allocate work, monitor performance and build team capability to support growing business needs.
 Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of finance processes and SOPs.
 Ensure finance policies and procedures are correctly understood and consistently applied across the team.
 Act as a key point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders on day-to-day finance matters.

 Key Skills & Competencies 

 Technical Skills 
 Strong working knowledge of accounting standards and their practical application.
 Hands-on experience with month-end close, reconciliations and financial statement preparation.
 Working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation and statutory compliance requirements.
 Proficiency with ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel; exposure to BI/reporting tools is an advantage.
 Sound understanding of internal controls, audit processes and revenue/cost reconciliation.

 Soft Skills & Behavioural Competencies 
 Strong people management and coaching skills, with the ability to lead and develop a small-to-mid-sized team.
 High attention to detail and accuracy, with a structured, process-driven approach to work.
 A strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently within defined policy.
 Effective communicator, able to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
 Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growing organisation with evolving processes.
 Sound judgement in escalating issues to senior management at the right time.

 Qualifications & Experience 

 MANDATORY PREREQUISITE – NON-NEGOTIABLE 
Candidates must hold a Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification. This is a strict must-have for this role — applications without CA/CPA qualification will not be considered.

 Required Qualifications 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) — mandatory (see prerequisite above).

 Experience 
 6–9 years of post-qualification experience in core accounting/finance roles.
 Demonstrated experience supervising and developing a finance team.
 Hands-on experience across month-end close, taxation, compliance, and AP/AR operations.
 Prior experience in a multi-entity, fast-growing, or dynamic organisation is preferred.
 Working exposure to ERP systems and statutory audit processes required.

This is a dual-focus role covering UK statutory audits and preparation of year-end financial statements under FRS 102 / FRS 105. The ideal candidate will have hands-on exposure to UK audit methodology, strong technical accounting knowledge, and the ability to take ownership of sections of an audit file and a set of year-end accounts from planning through to completion. Working from our Pitampura, Delhi office as part of an international cross-border team. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Statutory Audit (UK GAAP / ISA (UK)): Execute planning, fieldwork, and completion procedures on UK statutory audits under ISA (UK) , working under the direction of UK-based managers and the Responsible Individual (RI). Prepare audit working papers on areas such as revenue, purchases, payroll, fixed assets, cash & bank, debtors, creditors, accruals, prepayments, and related party transactions. Perform risk assessment, walkthroughs, tests of controls, substantive analytical procedures, and detailed substantive testing with appropriate sampling. Draft and refine audit file sections on CaseWare, Mercia, IRIS, or similar audit software, ensuring documentation meets ISA (UK) evidence and cross-referencing standards. Identify and escalate audit issues, control weaknesses, misstatements, and potential adjusting journal entries; draft management letter points. Support completion procedures analytical review, going concern assessment, subsequent events, and management representation letters. 
 Year-End Accounts Preparation: Prepare statutory financial statements for UK limited companies under FRS 102 (including Section 1A) and FRS 105 , in accordance with the Companies Act 2006. Post year-end adjustments depreciation, accruals, prepayments, deferred/current tax, dividends, directors' loans, corporation tax provisions and roll forward trial balances. Draft primary statements (Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss / Income Statement, Cash Flow where applicable) with supporting notes and required disclosures. Assist in preparing corporation tax computations (CT600) and iXBRL tagging where required, coordinating with the tax team. Reconcile prior-year comparatives, ensure consistency with statutory filings, and prepare files for RI/manager review. 
 Compliance & Coordination: Support VAT return reviews, HMRC filings, and confirm all engagements meet UK accounting, auditing, and tax standards. Liaise with UK-based managers, partners, and clients (via email/calls under supervision) to resolve queries and request supporting information. Ensure secure, confidential handling of client data in line with GDPR and firm-wide information security policies. 
 Continuous Improvement & Client Service: Identify and propose incremental improvements to audit and accounts preparation processes, checklists, and templates. Support the UK team in delivering excellent client service through clear communication, sound time management, and proactive follow-up. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Educational Background: ACCA (qualified or part-qualified), CA Inter (IPCC / Intermediate cleared) . Sound working knowledge of FRS 102, FRS 105, and ISA (UK) ; familiarity with the Companies Act 2006 disclosure framework.

Demonstrable exposure to UK statutory audits and year-end accounts preparation candidates with pure bookkeeping backgrounds only will not be suitable. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine: Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains Polished technical communications Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time. The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs. This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB. Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Cool things you'll do 
 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem What you need 
 You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes: Communicator: Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations) Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability Collaborator: Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts Problem Solver: Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos Technical Expert: Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP Builder: Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers Product evangelism: The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems 

 Bonus Points 
 Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL) Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures Microservices/Serverless architectures CI/CD tools and approaches Containerization, orchestration and management tools Enterprise Identity platforms Experience using or managing MongoDB Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering 

 Success Measures 
 In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

description:
As a market leader in providing illiquid portfolio analysis, our Alternative Asset Management professionals assist clients in the valuation of alternative investments, specifically for securities and positions for which there are no active market quotations available. Our professionals have the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects with exposure to the bespoke investment structures and asset classes of our institutional investor clientele.
   

  

 Kroll's
 **Financial Instruments and Technology (complex securities valuation)** 
 practice is a leading solutions provider for asset managers, hedge funds, fund administrators, banks, insurers, private equity firms, commodity trading and investment firms, and corporations. We are looking for Analyst’s who will be involved in providing support to our global valuation practice.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
 The Analyst will assist on a range of valuation advisory services to the alternative asset community and gain exposure to exciting the esoteric nature of such positions. Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Developing deep technical strength in the valuation of alternative assets, through direct exposure to high\-profile clients and alternative asset industry professionals
* Reviewing investment memoranda, governing documents of structured investments, board of directors’ presentations, and client models
* Assisting the team with interviewing clients, including preparing information request lists, participating in face\-to\-face meetings, to gather data and information pertinent to the engagement
* Assisting in the design of financial models for discounted cash flow, market multiple, market transaction and option pricing analyses
* Performing valuation analysis on a wide range of illiquid investments broadly distributed across industries and geographies while using accepted and relevant approaches and theory
* Compiling statistical summaries of companies’ financial information, developing and computing financial ratios, and presenting the analyses in an organized manner and/or using our standard formats and presentations
* Working with management to build, develop, and maintain client relationships
* Reporting and presenting analyses and conclusions including written reports, including assisting in the presentation of work products and conclusions internally to clients
* Attending relevant industry events to broaden your knowledge and experience within the alternative asset community


**Essential Traits**
* CA, Master's degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics or equivalent thereof (e.g., CFA); or MBA from an accredited college/university
* Minimum 0\-1 year of experience constructing and reviewing valuation models and other financial models including: enterprise valuation using DCF \& market approaches, and other structured investment models
* Experience with credit analysis or structured securities experience is a plus: CLOs, CMBS, RMBS, ABS, etc., Intex or other tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, as well as strong verbal and written communication skills
* A fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Excellent understanding of financial statements analysis with the ability to work through key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations
* Excellent attention to detail, strong work ethic, and ability to manage multiple ongoing assignments efficiently and accurately
* Familiarity with relevant accounting standards and policies produced and amended from time to time by the AICPA and other oversight bodies
* Knowledge of software packages including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Direct experience working with VBA, Python, and Power BI is highly desirable
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that help represent diverse communities
* Experience working with diverse teams

description:
Step into the role of Personal Banker at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
   

  

 You will be responsible for delivering personalised, compliant, and high\-quality customer service across multiple digital and in\-person channels while supporting efficient banking operations.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
   

  

  

* Resolve customer queries and issues efficiently while delivering a personalised experience across multiple communication channels.
* Provide exceptional customer service by handling inquiries, resolving issues, and supporting client requests accurately and on time.
* Collaborate with internal teams (sales, operations, risk, compliance) to meet customer needs and ensure smooth transaction execution.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management standards in all customer interactions.
* This is a voice role and minimum qualification required is graduate.


**Desirable Skills Set**
* Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to handle sensitive or complex information.
* Knowledge of banking operations, compliance, and risk management processes.
* International contact centre and voice experience preferred.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration across multiple digital channels to personalise each interaction with a customer.
* Enhancing the bank's digital capabilities when current technology is identified as not yet ready to support.
* Provision of exceptional customer service to clients by responding to inquiries, resolving issues and handling client requests efficiently.
* Support the collaboration of internal stakeholders including sales, operational, and risk management teams to meet client needs and expectations, so that transactions are executed accurately and on time.
* Support teams within the business operations function as needed, including risk management, compliance and collections.
* Comply with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer care.
* To provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and support
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub\-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:

 Experience: 1-4 years preferred
 Location: Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi
 Industry: Financial Services / Mutual Funds / Insurance 
 About the Role We are looking for a smart, organised and proactive Financial Services Executive to join our growing financial services business. The role will involve a combination of mutual fund and insurance operations, client servicing, financial transactions, documentation, communication and general business support . The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of financial products, excellent communication skills and be comfortable using technology and AI tools to work efficiently. This is a hands-on, non-routine role where the candidate will be expected to take ownership of tasks, coordinate with clients and service providers, and manage multiple responsibilities independently. 
 Key Responsibilities Mutual Fund & Investment Operations Initiate and process mutual fund transactions through NSE and other relevant platforms Handle purchase, redemption, switch, SIP and other investment transactions Assist with KYC, account opening, FATCA, documentation and related processes Coordinate with AMCs, RTAs, NSE and other platforms for transaction and service-related requirements Track pending transactions and ensure timely completion Maintain accurate client and transaction records Insurance Operations Assist with new insurance business, policy servicing and renewals Coordinate documentation and service requests with insurance companies Track policy renewals, pending requirements and client requests Maintain organised records of policies and related documentation Client Servicing Communicate with clients through phone, WhatsApp and email regarding transactions, documentation and service requirements Respond to routine client queries professionally and efficiently Coordinate client meetings and follow-ups Occasionally accompany or visit clients for documentation, servicing or other requirements Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients Technology & Business Support Maintain Excel/Google Sheets, digital records and databases Use online financial platforms, CRM tools and other business applications Effectively use AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, drafting, analysis, communication and improving day-to-day productivity Conduct online research and gather financial/product-related information when required Assist with occasional flight, hotel and other travel bookings Handle other operational and administrative responsibilities as required Entrepreneurial Mindset & Growth We are specifically looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit and an ownership mindset. You should be someone who: Treats the business and its clients with the same care and responsibility as you would your own business Looks for ways to improve processes, solve problems and make the business more efficient Is willing to take initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every task Is interested in learning and gradually taking on greater responsibility 
 Performance will be recognised and rewarded. Salary growth, bonuses and increased responsibilities will be linked to performance, initiative, contribution and the growth of the business. 
 What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate should be: Highly organised and detail-oriented Comfortable working with numbers, financial information and documentation Knowledgeable about mutual funds, investments, insurance and personal finance Excellent in spoken and written Hindi and English Confident and professional while communicating with clients Comfortable with computers, Excel/Google Sheets and online platforms Tech-savvy and interested in using AI tools to improve productivity A quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes Proactive and capable of taking ownership without constant supervision Good at following up and ensuring tasks are completed on time Presentable and comfortable with occasional client visits Reliable, responsible and discreet when handling client information Ambitious, self-motivated and entrepreneurial Preferred Qualifications & Experience Graduate in B.Com, BBA, Finance, Economics or a related field 1-4 years of experience in mutual funds, insurance, banking, wealth management, financial services or a similar role preferred Familiarity with NSE mutual fund transactions, AMC/RTA portals, KYC processes and insurance platforms will be an advantage Candidates with strong financial knowledge and excellent communication skills may also be considered even without direct industry experience Important This is primarily an operations and client servicing role, not a pure sales role. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys working across finance, technology, people and business operations and wants to develop a broad understanding of the financial services industry. We are looking for someone who wants to build something, take ownership and grow alongside the business.

title: Group Account Manager - Events & Exhibitions
description:
Group Account Manager 
 Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Group Account Manager to manage key client accounts and lead the execution of BTL marketing campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating with internal and external teams, driving account growth, and ensuring seamless execution of projects while meeting client expectations and business objectives. The candidate should have strong experience in client servicing, brand activations, events, exhibitions, and experiential marketing , along with the ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Account & Client Management Manage a portfolio of key client accounts and act as the primary point of contact. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders. Understand client briefs, business objectives, brand requirements, and project expectations. Ensure timely communication, follow-ups, approvals, and delivery across all accounts. Proactively identify client requirements and provide relevant solutions. Handle client escalations and ensure timely resolution of issues. 
 2. Campaign & Event Management Lead the planning and execution of BTL campaigns, events, activations, exhibitions, and brand experiences. Develop campaign approaches and execution plans in line with client objectives. Coordinate with creative, production, operations, and other internal teams for smooth project execution. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. Be actively involved in pre-event planning, on-ground execution, and post-event closure. Conduct post-project reviews and identify areas for improvement. 
 3. Business Development & Account Growth Identify opportunities for growth within existing accounts. Explore upselling and cross-selling opportunities across the agency's services. Support new business pitches, proposals, presentations, and client meetings. Develop a strong understanding of client businesses to identify potential opportunities. Contribute towards revenue growth and expansion of assigned accounts. 
 4. Team & Internal Coordination Lead and coordinate account servicing teams working across assigned accounts. Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of deliverables. Work closely with creative, production, operations, procurement, and finance teams. Ensure clear communication of client briefs and expectations to internal teams. Review team deliverables and provide necessary guidance and feedback. Support junior team members in managing client requirements and projects. 
 5. Creative & Strategic Collaboration Work closely with creative and strategy teams to develop relevant campaign concepts and solutions. Participate in brainstorming sessions, client presentations, and pitch discussions. Ensure creative solutions are aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives. Provide strategic inputs based on client requirements, market understanding, and campaign objectives. 
 6. Project & Operations Management Manage multiple projects simultaneously from briefing to execution and closure. Prepare and track project timelines, deliverables, approvals, and dependencies. Monitor project progress and proactively identify potential delays or challenges. Coordinate with vendors and external partners wherever required. Ensure smooth execution while maintaining quality and client expectations. 
 7. Budget & Commercial Management Support preparation and management of project budgets and estimates. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure cost-effective execution. Monitor project costs and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Support commercial negotiations with vendors and service partners. Ensure projects are executed efficiently without compromising quality. 
 8. Reporting & Documentation Prepare regular account updates, project status reports, presentations, and other client communication. Maintain proper documentation of briefs, approvals, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables. Track account activities and provide regular updates to senior management. Maintain accurate records of ongoing and completed projects. 
 9. Client Retention & Relationship Growth Understand client expectations and proactively address concerns. Maintain regular engagement with key client stakeholders. Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships and increase account engagement. Ensure a high level of client satisfaction across projects. Build trust with clients through consistent communication, ownership, and quality delivery. 
 10. Overall Ownership Take complete ownership of assigned accounts and projects. Ensure timely, high-quality, and commercially effective delivery. Demonstrate strong accountability and proactive problem-solving. Contribute to the overall growth, profitability, and reputation of the agency. Take greater responsibility for client relationships, team performance, and project outcomes. 
 Qualifications & Skills 3-4 years of relevant experience in BTL, events, activations, exhibitions, experiential marketing, or advertising agencies . Strong experience in client servicing and account management. Good understanding of brand activations, events, exhibitions, and experiential campaigns.
